title: Climate Risk Intelligence
prompt:
Create the comprehensive ClimateGuard AI 'Risk Intelligence' analysis workspace screen for desktop using the web_dashboard app shell.

PAGE CONTEXT & SHELL INTEGRATION:
- App title: ClimateGuard AI
- Active Nav: Highlight 'Risk Intelligence' in the MAIN MENU sidebar.
- Top Navbar: Show breadcrumbs 'Telemetry Operations > Risk Intelligence Workspace', Location quick-search input, System Normal 99.98% indicator, Notification Bell, User Avatar (Dr. Aris Thorne).

CONTENT SPECIFICATIONS (strictly following user request):
1. TOP FILTER & ANALYSIS CONTROL BAR:
   - Header title: 'Climate Risk Intelligence Engine'
   - Subtitle: 'Multi-hazard predictive synthesis, automated model inference, and calibrated exposure evaluation.'
   - Functional controls in a dark card toolbar:
     - Location selector dropdown: Selected 'Indus Basin & Thar Corridor (Zone 43N - South Asia)' with quick options (Rio Paraná Delta, Horn of Africa Sector 4, Lower Mekong Estuary).
     - Hazard selector: Multi-select/segmented buttons ('All Hazards (Synthesized)', 'Flood Inundation', 'Extreme Heatwave', 'Agricultural Drought').
     - Forecast period selector: Segmented pills or dropdown: '24 Hours', '48 Hours (Recommended)', '7 Days', '14 Days Ensemble'.
     - Model confidence toggle / ensemble version: 'ECMWF ERA5 + GFS + ClimateGuard C01 Edge v2.4'.
     - Primary Action Button: 'Run Risk Analysis' (electric cyan button #22D3EE with pulse/sparkle icon).
     - Secondary Action: 'Export Risk Assessment PDF/JSON' and 'Simulate Parametric Payout'.

2. ROW 1: THREE CORE HAZARD RISK ANALYSIS CARDS:
   - FLOOD RISK CARD:
     - Severity badge: 'CRITICAL (88% Threat)' in Red #EF4444.
     - Headline metric: 14,200 m³/s River Discharge (vs 12,000 m³/s 10-year Threshold).
     - Secondary metrics: 68.4 mm/24h precipitation, +1.8m gauge crest anomaly.
     - Contributing factors: Upstream glacial melt runoff (42%), Heavy monsoonal front convergence (38%), Saturated soil infiltration capacity < 8% (20%).
     - Model version: Hydro-Net v3.2 (Calibrated).
     - Status: Pre-breach active warning.
   - HEATWAVE RISK CARD:
     - Severity badge: 'HIGH ANOMALY (76% Index)' in Orange #F97316.
     - Headline metric: 46.2°C Ambient / 31.8°C Wet-Bulb Globe Temp (WBGT).
     - Secondary metrics: +6.4°C vs 30-year seasonal baseline, 78.4% relative humidity during night cycle.
     - Contributing factors: Persistent high-pressure atmospheric heat dome (55%), Low nighttime radiative cooling (25%), High surface urban albedo absorption (20%).
     - Model version: ThermoWatch v2.1.
     - Status: High heat-stress mortality exposure.
   - DROUGHT / ARIDITY RISK CARD:
     - Severity badge: 'MODERATE DEFICIT (64% Index)' in Yellow #EAB308.
     - Headline metric: -41% Root Zone Soil Moisture Deficit.
     - Secondary metrics: NDVI vegetation index deviation -0.32, 45 consecutive rain-free days.
     - Contributing factors: Consecutive failure of seasonal pre-monsoon showers (60%), Groundwater depletion acceleration (25%), Elevated evapotranspiration rate (15%).
     - Model version: AridScan v4.0.
     - Status: Agricultural stress watch.

3. ROW 2: DETAILED PREDICTIVE FORECAST CHARTS & HISTORICAL COMPARISON (2-column layout):
   - LEFT (60%): 'Multi-Model Risk Probability & Forecast Trajectory (7-Day Multi-Hazard Ensemble)'
     - Visual chart showing 3 distinct trend lines: Flood discharge curve (cyan/red peak), Heatwave temperature projection (orange curve), and Drought soil moisture depletion line (amber).
     - Clear 'T-Zero (Current Moment)' demarcation dividing 48h Observed historical telemetry from 120h Projected AI forecast.
     - Historical comparison callout overlay: 'Compared to 2010 Super-Flood & 2022 South Asian Heat Dome baselines: Exceeds 92nd percentile historic severity'.
   - RIGHT (40%): 'Hazard Factor Attribution & Sensitivity Weights'
     - Interactive breakdown bars and radial gauge showing model feature importance:
       - Upstream precipitation volume (Weight: 0.38)
       - Antecedent soil saturation (Weight: 0.28)
       - Surface radiative heating (Weight: 0.18)
       - Atmospheric barometric gradient (Weight: 0.16)
     - Risk Classification Matrix summary table with threshold triggers.

4. ROW 3: DEEP-DIVE RISK EXPLANATION & ACTIONABLE PROTOCOLS:
   - Panel 1: 'Algorithmic Risk Explanation & Causal Narrative'
     - Explainable AI summary: Clear breakdown of why the system reached an 88% Critical Flood threat and 76% Heatwave score, written in authoritative scientific risk assessment language.
     - Clear disclaimer: 'Note: River discharge thresholds are derived from satellite altimetry (Sentinel-3) and hydrological gauges. Inundation depth variations require local DEM ground truthing.'
   - Panel 2: 'Automated Parametric Trigger & Recommended Interventions'
     - Trigger Status: 'Parametric Condition CG-FIN-9821 Primed' (Discharge > 12,000 m³/s for > 6 consecutive hours).
     - Actionable recommendations: Municipal early evacuation advisory (Zone 2B), Deploy mobile flood barriers along eastern dyke, Pre-fund local disaster relief escrow via automated multi-sig.

5. FOOTER TELEMETRY & DATA PROVENANCE:
   - Data Sources: Open-Meteo Global (Synced 2m ago), NASA FIRMS MODIS/VIIRS (Active), Copernicus ERA5 Reanalysis, Sepolia Testnet Oracle block #9,481,204.
   - Timestamp: 'Forecast generated: 2026-10-24 14:32:10 UTC • Model Run #INF-8849-C01 • Confidence: 96.8% (ERA5+GFS calibrated)'.

STYLING & THEME:
- Dark navy palette: #07111F (background), #0B1728 (nav/sidebar), #101F33 (cards), #162840 (elevated cards), #24364B (borders).
- Risk color tokens: Green #22C55E (Safe), Yellow #EAB308 (Moderate), Orange #F97316 (High), Red #EF4444 (Critical), Primary Cyan #22D3EE.
- Modern high-density typography, tabular numerals, clean SVG mini-charts and gauges. No cartoon illustrations.
